intro.title: A Website Built Around Your Business, Not a Template
paragraphs: Templates and website builders make it easy to get something online, but thousands of other businesses use the same layouts. Your site ends up looking generic, carrying features you do not need and missing the ones you do. Custom web design starts from a blank page: your brand, your customers and what you want them to do.

Our custom website design and development process covers strategy, unique visual design, hand-coded development, content, SEO and launch. Every page layout, graphic and interaction is created for your business, and the site is built cleanly without heavy themes or piles of plugins, so it loads fast and is easy to grow. You can still update content yourself through a simple CMS.

We create custom websites for small businesses, growing brands, online stores, real estate companies and professional firms, with affordable packages and clear pricing. Want to compare options? See our <wd>web design services</wd>, our <dynamic>dynamic websites with admin panel</dynamic> or <contact>tell us about your business</contact>.

faqs.title: Custom Web Design FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers about custom website design and development.

items.a: Custom web design means creating a website from scratch for your business instead of using a pre-made template. The layout, visuals, features and code are planned around your brand, customers and goals.

items.q: Is a custom website better than a template?
items.a: A template is fine for a quick or personal site. A custom website gives you a unique look, faster and cleaner code, exactly the features you need and better room to grow, which usually means more trust and more enquiries.

items.q: How much does a custom website cost?
items.a: A small business custom website typically costs $1,000 to $3,000, a larger business website $3,000 to $8,000, and custom ecommerce or advanced websites from $8,000, depending on pages and features.

items.q: How long does it take to build a custom website?
items.a: Most small business custom websites take 3 to 4 weeks, larger business websites 4 to 8 weeks, and ecommerce or advanced builds 8 weeks or more, depending on content and feedback.

items.q: Do you offer affordable custom websites for small businesses?
items.a: Yes. Our small business packages give you a professional, custom-designed website with CMS, WhatsApp, maps and SEO at a fixed, affordable price.

items.q: Can I update the website myself and use my own domain?
items.a: Yes. Your custom website runs on your own domain and includes an easy CMS so you can update text, images and pages yourself. You own the design, code and content.
